rows.subtype: Hiraeth for a home and language left behind [Actor]

rows.subtype: Longing for a place that may no longer exist [Actor]
rows.description: A young professional working far from family visits the hometown and finds it changed; the longing is for a time as much as a place, and it cannot be fully satisfied.

rows.subtype: Parent at home yearning for the grown child [Observer]
rows.description: A young adult sees a parent pause at a photograph or keep the child's room ready; love now shows itself as waiting, and a call or a visit carries more than words.

rows.subtype: Carrying home while building a new one [Response]

rows.description: A toddler at nursery bursts into tears when another child does, without knowing why; feelings spread quickly between very young children.

rows.subtype: Embarrassed for a friend who is called out [Actor]

rows.subtype: Thrill at a team's win or a character's fate [Actor]

rows.subtype: Absorbing strangers' pain from the news feed [Actor]

rows.subtype: Feeling with others without taking the feeling over [Response]
